+## What
+Create `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/`, a macOS app with an `xcodeproj` generated the same way as `../EditorKit/Examples/Scripts/xcodeproj_generator.rb`, plus a `README.md` at the repo root.
+
+- Two tabs. "ACP": spawns an ACP agent through `AgentProcess` from a configurable command (default: the `acp-agent` binary from `../FoundationModelsACPAgent`), binds `ACPThreadSource` and `ACPThreadActions`, and shows `AgentThreadView`, `PromptInputView` with `ConfigOptionsView` and `PermissionModePicker`, `ContextUsageView`, and `SessionListView` in a sidebar. "FoundationModels": a `LanguageModelSession` on `SystemLanguageModel.default` with two sample tools, bound through `SessionThreadSource`.
+- A settings sheet with `ConnectionsView` and `AgentAuthView`.
+- A snippets folder `Examples/ReadmeSnippets/` compiled by a test, the EditorKit pattern, so every README code block builds.
+- `README.md`: install, a 60-second quick start for each source, the component list from plan.md §9, and a link to `plan.md`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The app builds with `xcodebuild -scheme AgentViewKitDemo build`.
+- [ ] Every README code block compiles through `ReadmeSnippetsTests`.
+- [ ] An end-to-end test launches the app against the in-memory ACP agent, sends "hello", and asserts an assistant message appears.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/Tests/DemoEndToEndTests.swift`: the send-and-receive flow through `XCUIApplication` with a launch argument that selects the in-memory agent.
+- [ ] `Tests/ReadmeSnippetsTests`: compiles the snippets.
+- [ ] `Scripts/test-examples.sh` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
